earnings.title: Press Release Contacts:
highlights: Net income attributable to AIG common shareholders $ 519 $ 844
Net income per diluted share attributable to AIG common shareholders $ 0.93 $ 1.60

For the third quarter of 2026, Net income attributable to AIG common shareholders was $844 million, or $1.60 per diluted common share, compared to $519 million, or $0.93 per diluted common share, in the prior year quarter.

AIG returned $787 million to shareholders in the third quarter of 2026 through $527 million of common stock repurchases, representing approximately 7 million shares, and $260 million of common stock dividends.
On November 3, 2026, the AIG Board of Directors declared a quarterly cash dividend on AIG common stock of $0.50 per share.

quotes.text: AIG delivered strong profitability and premium growth in the third quarter rounding out an outstanding first nine months of 2026.
quotes.by: Eric Andersen, AIG President & Chief Executive Officer
